newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-VOYLE WINS FIRST CAP, RUGBY LEAGUE MEN EXCLUDED.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-VOYLE WINS FIRST CAP, RUGBY LEAGUE MEN EXCLUDED.

text.p: Llanelli lock Mike Voyle is the only uncapped player named in the Wales' side for their international against France at Cardiff Arms Park on September 25.
Voyle, 26, takes over from Derwyn Jones in one of only two changes to the side who beat the Barbarians 31-10 last month.
New Zealand-born Hemi Taylor, who missed the Barbarians' match through injury, returns to the side of the scrum at the expense of Kingsley Jones.
None of the four former rugby league players included in the training squad have been selected.
"There is a genuine feeling among the rugby league players that they need more time to adjust to rugby union before stepping back onto the international stage," said Welsh coach Kevin Bowring.

Wales - Wayne Proctor; Ieuan Evans, Leigh Davies, Nigel Davies, Gareth Thomas; Neil Jenkins, Rob Howley; Steve Williams, Hemi Taylor, Mark Williams, Mike Voyle, Gareth Llewellyn, John Davies, Jonathan Humphreys, Christian Loader,
